(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 hole (D12) is dimensioned without any allowance for the I.Z.B.P. plating specified in the title block; if this hole receives a mating pin or shaft, the plating buildup will reduce its effective diameter and may cause interference. The designer should either add a plating-thickness allowance to the hole size or call out a mask area so the hole remains unplated.","recommended_correction":"Add a pre-plate tolerance or note that accounts for the plating thickness on the ⌀16 hole, or specify masking to keep it unplated."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 hole (D12) carries no fit or tolerance callout, yet as a central hole in a cam plate it is a functional/mating feature that must locate or receive another component. Without a defined fit, the machinist has no guidance beyond general tolerances, risking improper assembly or motion. The designer should assign an appropriate fit or explicit tolerance to this hole.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit designation (e.g., H7) or explicit dimensional tolerance to D12."}]}
